G1078.def:
**γένεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(γίγνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹלֵדֹת ;]
1. **origin, lineage**: βίβλος γενέσεως (as in [[Gen.2.4|Gen.2:4]]a 5:1), [[Mat.1.1|Mat.1:1]].
2. **birth**: [[Mat.1.18|Mat.1:18]], [[Luk.1.14|Luk.1:14]] (Rec. γέννησις); πρόσωπον τῆς γ., **face of his birth** ("what God made him to be," Hort., in l.), [[Jas.1.23|Jas.1:23]] ὁ τροχὸς τῆς γ., **the wheel (course) of birth** or **creation** ("the wheel of man's nature according to its original Divine purpose," Hort), [[Jas.3.6|Jas.3:6]]
† (AS)

G1080.def:
**γεννάω**, -ῶ
(γέννα, poët. for γένος), [in LXX chiefly for ילד ;]
1. of the father, **to beget**: with accusative, [[Mat.1.1-16|Mat.1:1-16]], [[Act.7.8, 29|Act.7:8, 29]]; before ἐκ, [[Mat.1.3, 5, 6|Mat.1:3, 5, 6]].
2. Of the mother, **to bring forth, bear**: [[Luk.1.13, 57; 23.29|Luk.1:13, 57 23:29]], [[Jhn.16.21|Jhn.16:21]]; εἰς δουλείαν, [[Gal.4.24|Gal.4:24]] Pass.
(1) **to be begotten**: [[Mat.1.20|Mat.1:20]]
(2) **to be born**: [[Mat.2.1, 4; 19.12; 26.24|Mat.2:1, 4 19:12 26:24]], [[Mrk.14.21|Mrk.14:21]], [[Luk.1.35|Luk.1:35]], [[Jhn.3.4|Jhn.3:4]], [[Act.7.20|Act.7:20]], [[Rom.9.11|Rom.9:11]], [[Heb.11.23|Heb.11:23]]; before εἰς, [[Jhn.16.21; 18.37|Jhn.16:21 18:37]], [[2Pe.2.12|2Pe.2:12]]; ἐν, [[Act.2.8; 22.3|Act.2:8 22:3]], (ἁμαρτίαις), [[Jhn.9.34|Jhn.9:34]] ἀπό, [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]] (WH, mg., ἐγεν-); ἐκ, [[Jhn.1.13|Jhn.1:13]] [[John.3.6; 8.41|3:6 8:41]]; with adj., τυφλὸς γ., [[Jhn.9.2|Jhn.9:2]] [Ῥωμαῖος ], [[Act.22.28|Act.22:28]] κατὰ σάρκα: κ. πνεῦμα: [[Gal.4.29|Gal.4:29]] Metaphorical; μάχας, [[2Ti.2.23|2Ti.2:23]] ὑμᾶς ἐγέννησα, [[1Co.4.15|1Co.4:15]], (ὅν), Phm 10; in quotation, [[Psa.2.7|Psa.2:7]] (LXX), [[Act.13.33|Act.13:33]], [[Heb.1.5; 5.5|Heb.1:5 5:5]]; of Christians as begotten of God, **born again**: [[Jhn.1.13; 3.3, 5-8|Jhn.1:13 3:3, 5-8]], [[1Jn.2.29; 3.9; 4.7; 5.1, 4, 18|1Jn.2:29 3:9 4:7 5:1, 4, 18]] (cf. ἀνα-γεννάω); (Cremer, 146).
(AS)

G1003.def:
**Βοός** and Βοές (RV, Βοάζ, Rec. Βοόζ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֹּעַז),
**Boaz** ([[Rut.2.1|Rut.2:1]]): [[Mat.1.5|Mat.1:5]], [[Luk.3.32|Luk.3:32]].†
(AS)

G1064.def:
**γαστήρͅ**, -τρός, ἡ,
[in LXX for בֶּטֶן, ἐν γ. ἔχειν for הרה, ἐν γ. λαμβάνειν for חרה ;]
1. **the belly**: metaphorically, **a glutton**, [[Tit.1.12|Tit.1:12]]
2. **the womb**: ἐν γ. ἔχειν, **to be with child**, [[Mat.1.18, 23|Mat.1:18, 23]]" (LXX) 24:19, [[Mrk.13.17|Mrk.13:17]], [[Luk.21.23|Luk.21:23]], [[1Th.5.3|1Th.5:3]], [[Rev.12.2|Rev.12:2]]; εν γ. συλλαμβ., **to conceive**, [[Luk.1.31|Luk.1:31]]
† (AS)

G1014.def:
**βούλομαι**,
[in LXX for חפץ, אבה, יעץ, etc. ;]
**to will, wish, desire, purpose, be minded**, implying more strongly than θέλω (which see), the deliberate exercise of volition (see Hort on [[Jas.1.18|Jas.1:18]]): with inf. (M, _Pr._, 205; Bl., §69, 4), [[Mrk.15.15|Mrk.15:15]], [[Act.5.28, 33; 12.4; 15.37; 17.20; 18.15, 27; 19.30; 22.30; 23.28; 27.43; 28.18|Act.5:28, 33 12:4 15:37 17:20 18:15, 27 19:30 22:30 23:28 27:43 28:18]], [[2Co.1.15|2Co.1:15]], [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]], [[Heb.6.17|Heb.6:17]], [[2Jn.12|II Jhn.12]], [[3Jn.10|3Jo.10]], [[Jude.5|Ju 5]]; with accusative, [[2Co.1.17|2Co.1:17]] with accusative and inf., [[Php.1.12|Php.1:12]], [[1Ti.2.8; 5.14|1Ti.2:8 5:14]], [[Tit.3.8|Tit.3:8]], [[2Pe.3.9|2Pe.3:9]]; of the will making choice between alternatives, [[Mat.1.19; 11.27|Mat.1:19 11:27]], [[Luk.10.22|Luk.10:22]], [[Act.25.20|Act.25:20]], [[1Co.12.11|1Co.12:11]], [[Jas.3.4; 4.4|Jas.3:4 4:4]]; εἰ βούλει (cl., a courteous phrase = θέλεις, colloq.; Bl., §21, 8; LS, see word), [[Luk.22.42|Luk.22:42]] with subjc., adding force to a question of deliberation (Bl., §64, 6), [[Jhn.18.39|Jhn.18:39]] βουληθείς, **of set purpose** (see Hort, in l.), [[Jas.1.18|Jas.1:18]] impf., ἐβουλόμην (= cl. βουλοίμην ἄν; Bl., §63, 5; Lft., _Phm._ 13), [[Act.25.22|Act.25:22]], Phm 13 (see also Cremer, 143).†
(AS)

G1063.def:
**γάρ**,
_co-ordinating particle_, contr. of γε ἄρα,
**verily then**, hence, **in truth, indeed, yea, then, why**, and when giving a reason or explanation, **for**, the usage in NT being in general accord with that of cl.;
1. **explicative and epexegetic**: [[Mat.4.18; 19.12|Mat.4:18 19:12]], [[Mrk.1.16; 5.42; 16.4|Mrk.1:16 5:42 16:4]], [[Luk.11.3|Luk.11:3]]o, [[Rom.7.1|Rom.7:1]], [[1Co.16.5|1Co.16:5]], al.
2. **Conclusive, in questions, answers and exclamations**: [[Mat.9.5; 27.23|Mat.9:5 27:23]], [[Luk.9.25; 22.27|Luk.9:25 22:27]], [[Jhn.9.30|Jhn.9:30]], [[Act.8.31; 16.37; 19.35|Act.8:31 16:37 19:35]], [[Rom.15.26|Rom.15:26]], [[1Co.9.10|1Co.9:10]], [[Php.1.18|Php.1:18]] (Ellic., in l.), [[1Th.2.20|1Th.2:20]], al.
3. **Causal**: [[Mat.1.21; 2.2, 5, 6, 3:23|Mat.1:21 2:2, 5, 6, 3:23]], [[Mrk.1.22; 9.6|Mrk.1:22, 9:6]], [[Luk.1.15, 18|Luk.1:15, 18]], [[Jhn.2.25|Jhn.2:25]], [[Act.2.25|Act.2:25]], [[Rom.1.9, 11|Rom.1:9, 11]], [[1Co.11.5|1Co.11:5]], [[Rev.1.3|Rev.1:3]], al.; giving the reason for a command or prohibition, [[Mat.2.20; 3.9|Mat.2:20 3:9]], [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]], [[Col.3.3|Col.3:3]], [[1Th.4.3|1Th.4:3]], al.; where the cause is contained in an interrog. statement, [[Luk.22.27|Luk.22:27]], [[Rom.3.3; 4.3|Rom.3:3 4:3]], [[1Co.10.29|1Co.10:29]]; καὶ γάρ, **for also**, [[Mrk.10.45|Mrk.10:45]], [[Luk.6.32|Luk.6:32]], [[1Co.5.7|1Co.5:7]], al. id. as in cl. = etenim, where the καί loses its connective force (Bl., §78, 6; Kühner 3, ii, 854f.), [[Mrk.14.70|Mrk.14:70]], [[Luk.1.66; 22.37|Luk.1:66 22:37]], [[2Co.13.4|2Co.13:4]]. The proper place of γάρ is after the first word in a clause, but in poets it often comes third or fourth, and so in late prose: [[2Co.1.19|2Co.1:19]] Yet "not the number but the nature of the word after which it stands is the point to be noticed" (see Thayer, see word).
(AS)

G1096.def:
**γίνομαι**, Ion. and κοινή for Att. γίγν- (M. _Pr._, 47; Bl., §6, 8 Mayser, 166 f.),
[in LXX chiefly for היה ;]
1. of persons, things occurrences, **to come into being, be born, arise, come on**: [[Jhn.1.15; 8.58|Jhn.1:15 8:58]], [[1Co.15.37|1Co.15:37]]; a first appearance in public, [[Mrk.1.4|Mrk.1:4]], [[Jhn.1.6|Jhn.1:6]], al.; before ἐκ (of birth), [[Rom.1.3|Rom.1:3]], [[Gal.4.4|Gal.4:4]]; διά, [[Jhn.1.3|Jhn.1:3]] βροντή, [[Jhn.12.29|Jhn.12:29]] σεισμός, [[Rev.6.12|Rev.6:12]] γογγυσμός, [[Act.6.1|Act.6:1]] χαρά, [[Act.8.8|Act.8:8]], many other similar exx.; ἡμέρα, [[Luk.22.66|Luk.22:66]], al.; ὀψέ, [[Mrk.11.19|Mrk.11:19]] πρωΐα, [[Mat.27.1|Mat.27:1]] νύξ, [[Act.27.27|Act.27:27]]
2. Of events, **to come to pass, take place, happen**: [[Mat.5.18|Mat.5:18]], [[Mrk.5.14|Mrk.5:14]], [[Luk.1.20; 2.15|Luk.1:20 2:15]], [[Act.4.21|Act.4:21]], [[2Ti.2.18|2Ti.2:18]], al.; μὴ γένοιτο [LXX for חָלִילָה, [[Jhn.22.29|Jhn.22:29]], al.], **far be it, God forbid**: [[Rom.3.4|Rom.3:4]] (_ICC_, in l.), [[1Co.6.15|1Co.6:15]] and frequently in Pl.; καὶ ἐγένετο, ἐγένετο δέ ([in LXX for וַיְהִי ;] see Burton, 142 f.; M, _Pr._, 16f.; Dalman, _Words_, 32 f.; Robertson, _Gr._, 1042 f.), with indic, [[Mat.7.28|Mat.7:28]], [[Luk.1.8|Luk.1:8]], al.; before καί and indic., [[Luk.8.1|Luk.8:1]], [[Act.5.7|Act.5:7]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[Mrk.2.23|Mrk.2:23]], [[Luk.3.21|Luk.3:21]], al.; ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο, before τοῦ with inf., [[Act.10.25|Act.10:25]] with dative of person(s), **to befall one**: with inf., [[Act.20.16|Act.20:16]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.22.6|Act.22:6]] with adv., εὖ, [[Eph.6.3|Eph.6:3]] τ́ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ (Field, _Notes_, 115), [[Act.7.40|Act.7:40]] (LXX); before εἰς, [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]]
3. **to be made, done, performed, observed, enacted, ordained**, etc.: [[Mat.6.10; 19.8|Mat.6:10 19:8]], [[Mrk.2.27; 11.23|Mrk.2:27 11:23]], [[Act.19.26|Act.19:26]], al.; before διά with genitive, [[Mrk.6.2|Mrk.6:2]], [[Act.2.43|Act.2:43]]; ὑπό, [[Luk.13.17|Luk.13:17]] ἐκ, [[Luk.4.23|Luk.4:23]] ἐν, [[1Co.9.15|1Co.9:15]] ἀπογραφή, [[Luk.2.2|Luk.2:2]] ἀνάκρισις [[Act.25.26|Act.25:26]] ἄφεσις, [[Heb.9.22|Heb.9:22]] ὁ νόμος, [[Gal.3.17|Gal.3:17]] τὸ πάσχα, [[Mat.26.2|Mat.26:2]]
4. **to become, be made, come to be**: with pred., [[Mat.4.3|Mat.4:3]], [[Luk.4.3|Luk.4:3]], [[Jhn.2.9|Jhn.2:9]], [[1Co.13.11|1Co.13:11]], al.; before ὡς, ὡσεί, [[Mat.10.25|Mat.10:25]], [[Mrk.9.26|Mrk.9:26]]; εἰς (M, _Pr._, 71f.), [[Mrk.12.1|Mrk.12:1]]o, al.; with genitive [[Rev.11.15|Rev.11:15]] id., of age, [[Luk.2.42|Luk.2:42]] with dative, γ. ἀνδρί ([LXX for הָיָה לְאִישׁ, [[Rut.1.12|Rut.1:12]], al. ;] see Field, _Notes_, 156), [[Rom.7.3|Rom.7:3]], 4; before ἐν, [[Act.22.17|Act.22:17]], [[Rev.1.10|Rev.1:10]], al.; ἐπάνω, [[Luk.19.19|Luk.19:19]] μετά, with genitive, Mrk.16:[10], [[Act.9.19|Act.9:19]]; before εἰς, ἐπί (Field, _Notes_, 135), κατά (ib., 62), with accusative of place, [[Act.20.16; 21.35; 27.7|Act.20:16 21:35 27:7]], al.; before ἐκ, [[Mrk.9.7|Mrk.9:7]], [[Luk.3.22|Luk.3:22]], [[2Th.2.7|2Th.2:7]], al. Aoristic pf. γέγονα (M, _Pr._, 52, 145f.; Field, _Notes_, 1f.), [[Mat.25.6|Mat.25:6]], [[Luk.10.36|Luk.10:36]], al. Aor. ἐγενήθη (for ἐγένετο, M, _Pr._, 139f.; Mayser, 379), [[Mat.11.23|Mat.11:23]], al. (Cf. απο-, δια-, επι-, παρα-, συμ-, παρα-, προ-.)
(AS)

G1097.def:
**γινώσκω** (= γιγν-: see previous word. So also vulgar Attic, in Inscr., see Thumb, _MGV_, 207),
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;]
**to be taking in knowledge, come to know, recognize, perceive, understand**; in past tenses **to know, realize**; pass., **to become known**: with accusative, [[Mat.22.18|Mat.22:18]], [[Mrk.5.43|Mrk.5:43]], [[Col.4.8|Col.4:8]], [[1Th.3.5|1Th.3:5]], al. Pass., [[Mat.10.26|Mat.10:26]], [[Php.4.5|Php.4:5]], al.; before ὅτι, [[Mat.21.45|Mat.21:45]], [[Jhn.4.1|Jhn.4:1]], al.; τί, [[Mat.6.3|Mat.6:3]] ἀπό, [[Mrk.15.45|Mrk.15:45]] ὅ, [[Rom.7.15|Rom.7:15]] τ. λεγόμενα, [[Luk.18.34|Luk.18:34]] τ. θέλημα, [[Luk.12.47|Luk.12:47]] τ. καρδίας, [[Luk.16.15|Luk.16:15]] with accusative of person(s), of recognition by God, [[1Co.8.3|1Co.8:3]], [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]]; by Christ, neg., [[Mat.7.23|Mat.7:23]] frequently of the knowledge of divine things, of God and Christ; τ. θεόν, [[Rom.1.21|Rom.1:21]] [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]]; τ. πατέρα, [[Jhn.8.55|Jhn.8:55]] τ. κύριον, [[Heb.8.1|Heb.8:1]] (LXX); νοῦν κυρίου, [[Rom.11.34|Rom.11:34]] Χριστόν, [[Jhn.17.3|Jhn.17:3]], [[1Jn.3.6|1Jn.3:6]]; τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, [[1Co.2.14|1Co.2:14]] τ. πνεύμα, [[1Jn.4.6|1Jn.4:6]] τ. ἀλήθειαν, [[Jhn.8.32|Jhn.8:32]] of Christ's knowledge of the Father (ἐπιγ.), [[Mat.11.27|Mat.11:27]] (Dalman, _Words_, 282ff.). In Hellenistic writers [LXX for Heb. ידע, [[Gal.4.1|Gal.4:1]], al.], of sexual intercourse, **to know** carnally: [[Mat.1.25|Mat.1:25]], [[Luk.1.34|Luk.1:34]] (Cremer, 153).
_SYN._: γ., **to know** by observation and experience is thus prop. disting. from οἶδα, to know by reflection (a mental process, based on intuition or information); cf. also ἐφίστημι, συνίημι. (Cf. ἀνα-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, προ-γινώσκω.) (AS)

G1056.def:
**Γαλιλαία**, -ας, ἡ (Heb. הַגָּלִיל, _the circle, district_),
**Galilee**, the name of the northern region of Palestine in NT times: Γ. τῶν ἐθνῶν, [[Mat.4.15|Mat.4:15]] (LXX); θάλασσα τῆς Γ., [[Mat.15.29|Mat.15:29]] (cf. [[Jhn.6.1|Jhn.6:1]]).
(AS)

G1081.def:
**γέννημα**, -τος, τό
(γεννάω), [in LXX chiefly for תְּבוּאָה ;]
**offspring** of men or animals: ἐχιδνῶν, [[Mat.3.7; 12.34; 23.33|Mat.3:7 12:34 23:33]], [[Luk.3.7|Luk.3:7]] (and elsewhere in Rec. for γένημα, which see).†
(AS)

G1067.def:
**γέεννα** (γέενα, [[Mrk.9.45|Mrk.9:45]], Rec.), -ης, ἡ (perh. through Aram. גֵּיהִנָּם, from Heb. גֵּי הִנֹּם, [[Neh.11.30|Neh.11:30]] גֵּי בֶּן־הִנֹּם, [[Jhn.18.16|Jhn.18:16]] גֵּי בּנֵי־הִנֹּם, [[2Ki.23.10|4Ki.23:10]] _valley of (the son, sons of) lamentation_);
[in LXX the nearest approach to γ. is γαίεννα, [[Jos.18.16|Jos.18:16]] (Γαὶ Ὀννόμ, A), elsewhere φάραγξ Ὀνόμ ([[Jos.15.8|Jos.15:8]], al.), V. Swete on [[Mrk.9.43|Mrk.9:43]] ;]
**Gehenna**, a valley W. and S. of Jerusalem, which as the site of fire-worship from the time of Ahaz, was desecrated by Josiah and became a dumping-place for the offal of the city. Later, the name was used as a symbol of the place of future punishment, as in NT: [[Mat.5.29|Mat.5:29]], [[Mat.10.28|; 10:28]], [[Mrk.9.43, 45, 47|Mrk.9:43, 45 47]], [[Luk.12.5|Luk.12:5]], [[Jas.3.6|Jas.3:6]]; γ. τ. πυρός, [[Mat.5.22; 18.19|Mat.5:22 18:19]], prob. with ref. to fires of Moloch (_DB_, ii, 119b); υἱὸς γεέννης, [[Mat.23.15|Mat.23:15]] κρίσις γεέννης, 23:33.†
(AS)

G1026.def:
**βρέχω**,
[in LXX chiefly for מטר ;]
1. **to wet**: [[Luk.7.38, 44|Luk.7:38, 44]].
2. In late Gk. writers and vernac. = ὕειν, **to send rain, to rain** (Kennedy, _Sources_, 39, 155): [[Mat.5.45|Mat.5:45]] trop., β. πῦρ κ. θεῖον, [[Luk.17.29|Luk.17:29]] impers., βρέχει, **it rains**: [[Jas.5.17|Jas.5:17]] with ὐετός as subj., [[Rev.11.6|Rev.11:6]]
† (AS)

G1065.def:
**γε**, _enclitic postpositive particle_, rarer in κοινή than in cl., giving special prominence to the word to which it is attached, distinguishing it as the least or the most important (Thayer, see word),
**indeed, at least, even** (but not always translatable into English);
1. **used alone**: [[Luk.11.8; 18.5|Luk.11:8 18:5]] [[Rom.8.32|Rom.8:32]].
2. More frequently with other particles: αλλά γε, [[Luk.24.21|Luk.24:21]], [[1Co.9.2|1Co.9:2]]; ἄρα γε, [[Mat.7.20; 17.26|Mat.7:20 17:26]], [[Act.17.27|Act.17:27]]; ἆρά γε, [[Act.8.30|Act.8:30]] εἴ γε (Rec. εἴγε), [[2Co.5.3|2Co.5:3]], [[Gal.3.4|Gal.3:4]], [[Eph.3.2; 4.21|Eph.3:2 4:21]], [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]] (see Meyer, Ellic., on Ga, Eph, ll. with; Lft., on Ga, Col, ll. with); εἰ δὲ μήγε, following an affirmation, [[Mat.6.1|Mat.6:1]], [[Luk.10.6; 13.9|Luk.10:6 13:9]]; a negation, [[Mat.9.17|Mat.9:17]], [[Luk.5.36, 37; 14.32|Luk.5:36, 37 14:32]], [[2Co.11.16|2Co.11:16]]; καί γε (Rec. καίγε, cl. καὶ . . . γε), [[Luk.19.42|Luk.19:42]] (WH om.), [[Act.2.18; 17.27|Act.2:18 17:27]]; καίτοιγε (L καίτοι γε, Tr. καί τοι γε), [[Jhn.4.2|Jhn.4:2]] μενοῦνγε (see see word); μήτι γε, see: μήτι; ὄφελόν, [[1Co.4.8|1Co.4:8]]
† (AS)

G1035.def:
**βρῶσις**, -εως, ἡ (cf. βιβρώσκω),
[in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of אכל ;]
1. **eating**: β. καὶ πόσις, [[Rom.14.17|Rom.14:17]], [[Col.2.16|Col.2:16]] (see Lft., _ICC_, in l.); with genitive obj., [[1Co.8.4|1Co.8:4]] metaphorically, **corrosion, rust**: [[Mat.6.19, 20|Mat.6:19, 20]].
2. As also in cl. (Hom., al.) = βρῶμα, **food**: [[Jhn.6.27|Jhn.6:27]]a, [[2Co.9.10|2Co.9:10]], [[Col.2.16|Col.2:16]] (EV, but see supr.). [[Heb.12.16|Heb.12:16]] metaphorically, of spiritual nourishment, [[Jhn.4.32; 6.27b, 55|Jhn.4:32 6:27b, 55]].†
(AS)

G1028.def:
**βροχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(βρέχω), [in LXX: Psa.67 (68):9, 104 (105):32 (גֶּשֶׁם)* ;]
1. = βροχετός, **a wetting** (in π., of irrigation in Egypt; Deiss., _LAE_, 77).
2. As in MGr. (Kennedy, _Sources_, 153), = ὑετός, **rain**: [[Mat.7.25, 27|Mat.7:25, 27]].
† (AS)

G1046.def:
**Γαδαρηνός**, -ή, -όν
(Γαδαρά, _Gadara_, the capital of Peræa),
**Gadarene, of Gadara**: [[Mat.8.28|Mat.8:28]] (Rec. Γεργεσηνῶν), [[Mrk.5.1|Mrk.5:1]], Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν), [[Luk.8.26, 37|Luk.8:26, 37]] Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν).†
(AS)

G1006.def:
**βόσκω**,
[in LXX for רעה ;]
prop., of a herdsman, **to feed**: [[Mat.8.33|Mat.8:33]], [[Mrk.5.14|Mrk.5:14]], [[Luk.8.34; 15.15|Luk.8:34 15:15]]; metaphorically, of Christian pastoral care, [[Jhn.21.15, 17|Jhn.21:15, 17]]. Pass., of cattle, **to feed, graze**: [[Mat.8.30|Mat.8:30]], [[Mrk.5.11|Mrk.5:11]], [[Luk.8.32|Luk.8:32]].†
_SYN._: ποιμαίνειν, **to tend, shepherd**, a wider term, including oversight as well as feeding (see Tr., _Syn._, §xxv). (AS)

G1084.def:
**γεννητός**, -ή -όν
(γεννάω), [in LXX: [[Job.11.2, 12; 14.1; 15.14; 25.4|Job.11:2, 12 14:1 15:14 25:4]] (ילד)* ;]
**begotten, born**: pl., γ. γυναικῶν (cf. יְלוּד אִשָּׁה, [[Job.14.1|Job.14:1]]), periphrasis for mankind, [[Mat.11.11|Mat.11:11]], [[Luk.7.28|Luk.7:28]] (Cremer, 147).
(AS)

G1077.def:
**γενέσια**, -ων, τά, neut. pl. of adj. -ιος, -ον, relating to birth (γένεσις);
1. in Attic Gk., **a commemoration of the dead**.
2. In late Gk., **a birthday feast** (= cl. γενέθλια; so in π., see MM, _Exp._, x; cf. also Ῥutherford, _NPhr._, 184): [[Mat.14.6|Mat.14:6]], [[Mrk.6.21|Mrk.6:21]].
† (AS)

G1082.def:
**Γεννησαρέτ** (Rec. Γενησ-, Mk, l.with; Targ. גְּנֵיסַר),
[in LXX: Γεννησάρ (as in some MSS. Mt, Mk), [[1Ma.11.67|1Ma.11:67]] * ;]
**Gennesaret**, a fertile plain on W. shore of the Sea of Galilee; ἡ γῆ, [[Mat.14.34|Mat.14:34]], [[Mrk.6.53|Mrk.6:53]]; ἡ λίμνη (יָם כִּנֶּרֶת, [[Num.34.11|Num.34:11]], elsewhere ἡ θάλασσα τ. Γαλιλαίας, [[Mrk.1.16|Mrk.1:16]] ἡ θ. τ. Τιβεριάδος, [[Jhn.6.1|Jhn.6:1]]), [[Luk.5.1|Luk.5:1]].†
(AS)

G1089.def:
**γεύω**, **γεύομαι**,
[in LXX chiefly for טעם ;]
**to make to taste**. Mid., **to taste eat**: absol., [[Act.10.10; 20.11|Act.10:10 20:11]], [[Col.2.21|Col.2:21]]; with genitive, [[Mat.27.34|Mat.27:34]], [[Luk.14.24|Luk.14:24]], [[Act.23.14|Act.23:14]]; with accusative (not cl., but see Westc, _Heb._, l.with; M, _Pr._, 66, 245), [[Jhn.2.9|Jhn.2:9]] Metaphorical, [[Heb.6.4|Heb.6:4]] ῥῆμα θεοῦ, [[Heb.6.5|Heb.6:5]] (on case, see supr., and cf. Milligan, _NTD_, 68) θανάτου (cf. Talmudic טַעַם מִיתָה), [[Mat.16.28|Mat.16:28]], [[Mrk.9.1|Mrk.9:1]], [[Luk.9.27|Luk.9:27]], [[Jhn.8.52|Jhn.8:52]], [[Heb.2.9|Heb.2:9]]; before ὅτι, [[1Pe.2.3|1Pe.2:3]] (Cremer, 148).†
(AS)

G1061.def:
**γαμίζω**
(γάμος),
**to give in marriage**, **a daughter**: [[1Co.7.38|1Co.7:38]] Pass., [[Mat.22.30; 24.38|Mat.22:30 24:38]], [[Mrk.12.25|Mrk.12:25]], [[Luk.17.27; 20.35|Luk.17:27 20:35]] (WH, mg., γαμίσκονται; cf. γαμίζω).†
(AS)

G1073.def:
**γέμω** (used only in present and impf.),
[in LXX for מלא, נשׂא ;]
**to be full**;
1. properly, of a ship (Xen.).
2. Generally (Plat., al.),
(a) with genitive of thing(s): [[Mat.23.27|Mat.23:27]], [[Luk.11.39|Luk.11:39]], [[Rom.3.14|Rom.3:14]]" (LXX), [[Rev.4.6, 8; 5.8; 15.7; 17.3|Rev.4:6, 8 5:8 15:7 17:3]] (Rec.) 4 21:9
(b) before ἐκ: [[Mat.23.25|Mat.23:25]]
(with) with accusative of thing(s) (called a solecism in WM, 251; Bl., §36, 4), as in later Gk. from Byz. to Mod. times (Jannaris, _Gr._, 1319): [[Rev.17.3|Rev.17:3]]
† (AS)

G1068.def:
**Γεθσημασεί** (Rec. -νῆ, LTr. -νεῖ) indecl. (Heb. גֵּת שְׁמָנִי, _oil-press_),
**Gethsemane**: called in [[Jhn.18.1|Jhn.18:1]] a κῆπος, but named only in [[Mat.26.36|Mat.26:36]], [[Mrk.14.32|Mrk.14:32]].†
(AS)

G1072.def:
**γεμίζω**
(γέμω), [in LXX: [[Gen.45.17|Gen.45:17]] (טען), [[3Ma.5.47|3Ma.5:47]], [[4Ma.3.14|4Ma.3:14]] * ;]
**to fill**;
1. **properly, of a ship **(Thuc, al.): [[Mrk.4.37|Mrk.4:37]] (pass.).
2. In late writers, generally (MGr., see Kennedy, _Sources_, 155), with accusative, before genitive, [[Mrk.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[Jhn.2.7; 6.13|Jhn.2:7 6:13]], [[Rev.15.8|Rev.15:8]]; ἀπό, [[Luk.15.16|Luk.15:16]], Rec. WH, mg.; ἐκ, [[Luk.15.16|Luk.15:16]], WH, [[Rev.8.5|Rev.8:5]] Pass., absol.: [[Luk.14.23|Luk.14:23]]
† (AS)

G1086.def:
**Γεργασηνός**, -ή, -όν,
**Gerasene, of Gerasa**, not the G. of Decapolis, 30 m. S.E. of the Lake, but a Gerasa or Gergesa (perh. the mod. _Kersa_) on E. shore; as subst., pl. οἱ Γ., [[Mrk.5.1|Mrk.5:1]], [[Luk.8.26, 37|Luk.8:26, 37]] (Γεργεσηνῶν, RV, mg. 1; Γαδαρηνῶν, RV, mg. 2).†
(AS)

G1049.def:
**γαζο-φυλάκιον**, -ου, τό
(γάζα, φυλακή), [in LXX chiefly for לִשְׁכָּה, נִשְׁכָּה ([[2Ki.23.11|4Ki.23:11]], al.), once for גְּנָזִים ([[Est.3.9|Est.3:9]]); το͂ γ., τᾶ γ., of a temple treasury, [[Neh.10.37|Neh.10:37]], [[2Ma.3.6|2Ma.3:6]], al. ;]
**treasury**: also, **apparently, the trumpet-shaped chests into which the peoples' temple-offerings were thrown **(_DB_, iv, 96; _DCG_, ii, 748): [[Mrk.12.41, 43|Mrk.12:41, 43]] [[Luk.21.1|Luk.21:1]], [[Jhn.8.20|Jhn.8:20]].†
(AS)

G1010.def:
**βουλευτής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(βουλεύω), [in LXX: [[Job.3.14; 12.17|Job.3:14 12:17]] (יעץ)* ;]
**a councillor, a senator**; of a member of the Sanhedrin: [[Mrk.15.34|Mrk.15:34]], [[Luk.23.50|Luk.23:50]].†
(AS)

G1043.def:
**Γαβριήλ**, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גַּבְרִיאֵל, **hero of God**),
the archangel **Gabriel**: [[Luk.1.19, 26|Luk.1:19, 26]].†
(AS)

G1094.def:
**γῆρας**, Attic, genitive (-αος) -ως, dative ᾳ; Ion. and κοινή, -εος (-ους), dative -ει, τό,
[in LXX for שֵׂיבָה, etc. ;]
**old age**: ἐν γήρει, [[Luk.1.36|Luk.1:36]]†
(AS)

G1023.def:
**βραχίων**, -ὀνος, ὁ,
[in LXX, β. Κυρίου, frequently for זְרוֹעַ יהוָֹה ;]
**the arm**; as in OT, β. Κυρίου, metaphorically, **for the Divine power**: [[Luk.1.51|Luk.1:51]], [[Jhn.12.38|Jhn.12:38]]" (LXX), [[Act.13.17|Act.13:17]]†
(AS)

G1015.def:
**βουνός**, -οῦ, ὁ (a Cyrenaїc word, Hdt., iv, 199),
[in LXX chiefly for גִּבְעָה ;]
**a hill**: [[Luk.3.5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX) 23:30.†
(AS)

G1036.def:
**βυθίζω**
(βυθός), [in LXX: [[2Ma.12.4|2Ma.12:4]] * ;]
trans., **to cause to sink, to sink**: metaphorically, εἰς ὄλεθρον, [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]] pass., **to sink**, intrans.: [[Luk.5.7|Luk.5:7]]†
(AS)

G1070.def:
**γελάω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for צחק, שׂחק ;]
**to laugh**: [[Luk.6.25|Luk.6:25]] fut., γελάσω) (M, _Pr._, 154), ib. 21 (cf. κατα-γελάω).†
(AS)

G1012.def:
**βουλή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(βούλομαι), [in LXX frequently for עֵצָה ;]
**counsel, purpose** (in cl., esp. of the gods): [[Luk.23.51|Luk.23:51]], [[Act.4.28; 5.38; 19.1; 27.12, 42|Act.4:28 5:38 19:1 27:12, 42]]; pl., [[1Co.4.5|1Co.4:5]] of the Divine purpose, [[Heb.6.17|Heb.6:17]] τ. βουλὴν τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, [[Eph.1.11|Eph.1:11]] β. τ. Θεοῦ, [[Luk.7.30|Luk.7:30]], [[Act.2.23; 13.36; 20.27|Act.2:23 13:36 20:27]].†
(AS)

G1005.def:
**βορρᾶς**, -ᾶ (Attic contr. of Βορέας, the North wind personified),
[in LXX for צָפוֹן ;]
1. **Boreas, the North wind**.
2. **the north**: [[Luk.13.29|Luk.13:29]], [[Rev.21.13|Rev.21:13]].
† (AS)

G1069.def:
**γείτων**, -ονος, ὁ, ἡ
(γῆ), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכֵן ;]
**a neighbour**: [[Luk.14.12; 15.6, 9|Luk.14:12 15:6, 9]] [[Jhn.9.8|Jhn.9:8]].†
(AS)

G1011.def:
**βουλεύω**
(βουλή), [in LXX chiefly for יעץ ;]
**to take counsel, deliberate, resolve**. In mid.,
1. **to take counsel with oneself, consider**: before εἰ, [[Luk.14.31|Luk.14:31]]
2. **to determine with oneself, resolve**: with inf., [[Act.5.33; 27.39|Act.5:33 27:39]]; with accusative, [[2Co.1.17|2Co.1:17]] before ἵνα, [[Jhn.11.53; 12.10|Jhn.11:53 12:10]] (cf. παρα-, συμ-).
† (AS)

G1040.def:
**βύσσος**, -οῦ, ἡ (cf. Heb. בּוּץ),
[in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ ;]
**byssus**, a fine species of flax, also the **linen** made from it: [[Luk.16.19|Luk.16:19]]†
(AS)

G1024.def:
**βραχύς**, -εῖα, -ύ,
[in LXX chiefly for מְעַט ;]
**short**;
(a) **of time**; **short, little**: βραχύ, [[Act.5.34|Act.5:34]] μετὰ β., [[Luk.22.58|Luk.22:58]] β. τι, **a short time**, [[Heb.2.7|Heb.2:7]], 9 RV, mg.;
(b) **of distance**: [[Act.27.28|Act.27:28]]
(with) of quantity or value, **little, few**: [[Jhn.6.7|Jhn.6:7]], [[Heb.2.7|Heb.2:7]], 9 RV, txt.; pl., διὰ βραχέων, **in few words**, [[Heb.13.22|Heb.13:22]]
† (AS)

G1021.def:
**βραδύς**, -εῖα, -ύ,
**slow**: εἰς τὸ λαλῆσαι, [[Jas.1.19|Jas.1:19]] metaphorically, of the understanding: β. τ. καρδίᾳ, assoc. with ἀνόητος, [[Luk.24.25|Luk.24:25]]†
(AS)

G1088.def:
**γέρων**, -οντος, ὁ,
[in LXX for זָקֵן ;]
**an old man**: [[Jhn.3.4|Jhn.3:4]]†
(AS)

G1079.def:
**γενετή**, -ῆς, ἡ = γενεή, Ion. for γενεά,
[in LXX: [[Lev.25.47|Lev.25:47]] (עֵקֶר מִשְׁפָּחָו), [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]] * ;]
**birth**: ἐκ γ., [[Jhn.9.1|Jhn.9:1]]†
(AS)

G1042.def:
**Γαββαθα** (Rec. -θᾶ), ἡ, indecl.,
**Gabbatha**, the Greek transliteration of an uncertain Aramaic word (_DB_, see word; Dalman, _Words_, 7), used as the equivalent of λιθόστρωτον, **stone pavement**: [[Jhn.19.13|Jhn.19:13]]†
(AS)

G1095.def:
**γηράσκω** (also γηράω; γῆρας),
[in LXX chiefly for זקן ;]
**to grow old**: [[Jhn.21.18|Jhn.21:18]], [[Heb.8.13|Heb.8:13]].†
_SYN._: παλαιοῦμαι. (AS)

G1098.def:
**γλεῦκος (-εος)**, -ους, τό,
[in LXX for יַיִן, [[Job.32.19|Job.32:19]] * ;]
**must, sweet new wine** (Arist.): [[Act.2.13|Act.2:13]]†
(AS)

G1087.def:
**γερουσία**, -ας, ἡ
(γέρων), [in LXX (Hex. only in OT) for זָקֵן ;]
**a council of elders, senate**; in NT, of the Sanhedrin (_Cl. Rev._, i, 43f.; _DB_, _ext._, 99): [[Act.5.21|Act.5:21]]†
(AS)

G1059.def:
**Γαμαλιήλ**, ὁ (Heb. גַּמְלִיאֵל),
**Gamaliel** the elder, a Pharisee and Doctor of the Law: [[Act.5.34; 22.3|Act.5:34 22:3]].†
(AS)

G1031.def:
**βρύχω** (Attic, βρύκω),
[in LXX: [[Job.16.10|Job.16:10]](9), Psa.34 (35):16 36 (37):12 111 (112):10, [[Lam.2.16|La 2:16]] (חרק)* ;]
1. **to bite or eat greedily**.
2. **to gnash, grind**, **with the teeth**: [[Act.7.54|Act.7:54]]
† (AS)

G1048.def:
**Γάζα -ης**, ἡ (Heb. עַזָּה),
**Gaza**, in OT, one of the five chief cities of the Philistines: [[Act.8.26|Act.8:26]]†
(AS)

G1038.def:
**βυρσεύς**, -έως, ὁ (βύρσα, _a hide_), late form for βυρσοδέψης,
**a tanner**: [[Act.9.43; 10.6, 32|Act.9:43 10:6, 32]].†
(AS)

G1041.def:
**βωμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(βαίνω), [in LXX (Hex.) for מִזְבֵּחַ, in Proph., chiefly for בָּמָה ;]
1. any **raised place, a platform**.
2. **an altar**: [[Act.17.23|Act.17:23]] (cf. θυσιαστήριον and see _DB_, i, 75).
† (AS)

G1050.def:
**Γαῖος**, -ου, ὁ (Γάϊος, Rec.),
**Gaius**, the name of a Christian;
1. **of Macedonia**: [[Act.19.29|Act.19:29]]
2. **Of Derbe**: [[Act.20.4|Act.20:4]]
3. **Of Corinth**: [[Rom.16.23|Rom.16:23]], [[1Co.1.14|1Co.1:14]].
4. The one to whom in Ep. Jo is addressed: [[3Jn.1|III Jo 1]].
† (AS)

G1001.def:
**βολίζω**
(βολίς, in sense of _sounding-lead_),
**to heave the lead, take soundings**: [[Act.27.28|Act.27:28]]†
(AS)

G1051.def:
**γάλα**, -ακτος, τό
[in LXX for חלב ;]
**milk**: [[1Co.9.7|1Co.9:7]] Metaphorical, of elementary Christian teaching: [[1Co.3.2|1Co.3:2]], [[Heb.5.12, 13|Heb.5:12, 13]]; τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γ., **the rational (spiritual) genuine milk** (see Hort, in l.), [[1Pe.2.2|1Pe.2:2]] (in support of AV, **milk of the word**, see _ICC_, in l.).†
(AS)

G1091.def:
**γεώργιον**, -ου, τό
(γεωργός), [in LXX, frequently in Pr., for שָׂדֶה, etc. ;]
1. **a field** ([[Pro.24.5, 30|Pro.24:5, 30]], Strabo).
2. **cultivation, husbandry, tillage** ([[Pro.6.7; 9.12|Pro.6:7 9:12]], [[Jer.28.23|Jer.28:23]], [[Sir.27.6|Sir.27:6]]): [[1Co.3.9|1Co.3:9]].
† (AS)

G1029.def:
**βρόχος**, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: [[Pro.6.5|Pro.6:5]] (יָד) 7:21 (חֵלֶק) 22:25 (מוֹקֵשׁ), [[3Ma.4.8|3Ma.4:8]] * ;]
**a noose, a slip-knot, a halter**: metaphorically, **a restraint** (not, as AV, R, txt., **a snare**): [[1Co.7.35|1Co.7:35]]†
(AS)

G1017.def:
**βραβεῖον**, -ου, τό
(βραβεύς, _an umpire_),
**a prize** in the games: [[1Co.9.24|1Co.9:24]] metaphorically, of the Christian's reward, [[Php.3.14|Php.3:14]]†
(AS)

G1053.def:
**Γαλατία**, -ας, ἡ,
**Galatia**;
1. a gentilic region in Asia Minor, settled by Gauls (iii/B.C).
2. **A Roman Province which included this region **(_DB_, ii, 85ff.): [[1Co.16.1|1Co.16:1]], [[Gal.1.2|Gal.1:2]], [[2Ti.4.10|2Ti.4:10]] (T, Tr., mg., Γαλλίαν), [[1Pe.1.1|1Pe.1:1]]
† (AS)

G1052.def:
**Γαλάτης**, -ου, ὁ (originally syn. with cl. Κέλτης; cf. [[1Ma.8.2|1Ma.8:2]], and see next word),
**a Galatian**: [[Gal.3.1|Gal.3:1]]†
(AS)

G1018.def:
**βραβεύω**
(βραβεύς, _an umpire_), [in LXX: [[Wis.10.12|Wis.10:12]] * ;]
(a) prop., **to act as umpire**; hence,
(b) generally, **to arbitrate, decide** (Isocr., Dem.; Lft., _Col._, l.with; MM, see word): [[Col.3.15|Col.3:15]]
(with) in some late writers, **to direct, rule, control** (so in Col., l.with, accusative to Thayer, see word, Meyer, in l.), (cf. κατα-βραβεύω).
† (AS)

G1076.def:
**γενεαλογία**, -ας, ἡ (see previous word);
1. **the making of a pedigree**.
2. **a genealogy**: pl., [[1Ti.1.4|1Ti.1:4]], [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]] (see _CGT_, in l., and ib. _Intr._, xlix ff.; _DB_, ii, p. 141).
† (AS)

G1019.def:
**βραδύνω**
(βραδύς), [in LXX: [[Gen.43.10|Gen.43:10]] (מההּ hith.), [[Deu.7.10|Deu.7:10]], [[Isa.46.13|Isa.46:13]] (אחר pi.), Si 32 (35):18 * ;]
1. trans., **to retard** (Soph., Is, l.with).
2. More frequently intrans., **to be slow, to tarry**: [[1Ti.3.15|1Ti.3:15]], [[2Pe.3.9|2Pe.3:9]].
† (AS)

G1044.def:
**γάγγραινα**, -ης, ἡ,
**a gangrene, an eating sore**, **which leads to mortification**: [[2Ti.2.17|2Ti.2:17]]†
(AS)

G1008.def:
**βοτάνη**, -ῆς, ἡ
(βόσκω), [in LXX for עֵשֶׂב, דֶשֶׁא, חָצִיר ;]
1. **grass, fodder**.
2. **green herb**: [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]]†
_SYN._: λάχανον, _a garden herb_, a vegetable. (AS)

G1090.def:
**γεωργέω**, -ῶ
(γεωργός), [in LXX: [[1Ch.27.26|1Ch.27:26]] (עָשָׂה מְלֶאכֶת הַשָּׂדֶה), I [[Est.4.6|Est.4:6]], [[1Ma.14.8|1Ma.14:8]] * ;]
**to till** the ground: pass., [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]]
(AS)

G1075.def:
**γενεαλογέω**, -ῶ
(γενεά, λέγω), [in LXX: [[1Ch.5.1|1Ch.5:1]] (יחשׁ)* ;]
**to trace ancestry, reckon genealogy**; pass., before ἐκ: [[Heb.7.6|Heb.7:6]]†
(AS)

G1066.def:
**Γεδεών**, ὁ, indecl. in LXX and NT, in FlJ, _Ant._, see 6, 3 and 4 -ῶνος (Heb. גִּדְעוֹן),
**Gideon** (Jdg.6-8): [[Heb.11.32|Heb.11:32]].†
(AS)

G1032.def:
**βρύω**, poët., late prose and vernac.,
**to be full to bursting**;
1. of the earth producing vegetation.
2. Of plants putting forth buds.
3. Of springs, **to gush with** water: [[Jas.3.11|Jas.3:11]]
† (AS)

G1099.def:
**γλυκύς**, -εῖα, -ύ,
[in LXX chiefly for מָתוֹק ;]
[[Jas.3.11, 12|Jas.3:11, 12]]; opposite to πικρόν, ἁλυκόν, [[Rev.10.9, 10|Rev.10:9, 10]].†
(AS)

G1007.def:
**Βοσόρ** see Βεώρ - ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּעוֹר),
**Beor**, father of Balaam: [[2Pe.2.15|2Pe.2:15]] (Rec. Βοσόρ).†
(AS)

G1022.def:
1. **slowness **, (Iliad by Homer), attic
2. of the mind, (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1009.def:
**βότρυς**, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX for אֶשְׁכֹּל ;]
**a cluster of grapes**: [[Rev.14.18|Rev.14:18]] (cf. στραφυλή) .†
(AS)

G1039.def:
**βύσσινος**, -η, -ον
(βύσσος), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ, etc. ;]
made of βύσσος, **fine linen**: [[Rev.18.12, 16; 19.8, 14|Rev.18:12, 16 19:8, 14]].†
(AS)
